server.name: POX Revit MCP
server.instructions: Use these tools for read-only inspection of the active Autodesk Revit model through POX. Never claim that a result changed the model; this MCP surface is read-only.

tools.name: pox_active_document_info
tools.title: Active document info
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what Revit document/model is active, including title, path, active view, selection count, and warning count.

tools.name: pox_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which Revit model categories exist in the active document and how many elements are in each category.

tools.name: pox_query_elements
tools.title: Query elements
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for a read-only table of Revit elements by category and parameter filters. The MVP supports Doors, including Fire Rating, Mark, Type, Level, Width, and Height.

tools.name: pox_current_selection
tools.title: Current selection
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what elements are currently selected in Revit.

tools.name: pox_warnings_summary
tools.title: Warnings summary
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for a grouped summary of warnings in the active Revit document.
